scope_warnings: 3% is the original heuristic candidate rule, not a statistical confidence region
Finite representative fitted points do not cover continuous optimal faces or all alternate topology families
If the raw point generates voltage, its positive weak blocks remain part of that model; replacing its target by contracted supports silently changes the estimand
To use contracted family as a generating explanation, jointly refit that family on complete historical observations; do not call zeroing dropped coefficients a refit
Planning true block labels or physical truth were not used
Original fixed upper2 domain is retained by the archive; absence of bound touches establishes only conditional objective invariance for those fixed-family interior optima

upper_bound_lemma.statement: For one fixed support F with unchanged convex objective and constraints, if an exact optimum theta_star in [0,2] has all free coefficient coordinates strictly below2, removing upper2 cannot improve that fixed-family optimal value. Zero lower weights remain allowed.
upper_bound_lemma.proof: If nonnegative theta_bar had smaller objective, choose sufficiently small lambda>0 so theta_lambda=(1-lambda)*theta_star+lambda*theta_bar stays within the box; convexity gives strictly smaller objective, contradiction.
does_not_cover: other originally clipped or omitted families
